comment: The Rytm mod builds this release offers. scripts/make_patches.py turns each into patcher/patches/sidecar-<tag>.json. The first build is the default.

builds.title: rui1026: Sidecar 0.1.0 mods + remote pages (default, recommended)
builds.description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote pages: a connect screen when the Sidecar comes up, and with TRK + YES the SIDECAR and SYSTEM status pages, SCOPE and meters, the LFO page (TRK + LFO), the REC page with playback and channel picking on the trig keys (Sidecar on the Pi) and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font, on Sidecar Mini and Sidecar; the Rytm's FX return on IN L/R for recording and SCOPE. The page catches only the keys and knobs it uses: PLAY / STOP / RECORD always reach the Rytm, pads, mutes, FILL and tap tempo work as usual.

builds.title: sfx1021: Sidecar mods without the remote pages
builds.description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP, JUNO, FM, DIGIDRUM, DSP SAMPLE and user machines) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels, stepped lists), and the SIDECAR folder in the sample browser. The same mods as rui1026 without the remote pages.
